problem: A source without an additional paper block gained an orphan *Paper_Space0 BLOCK_RECORD because the omission guard treated even a bounded IMAGE-related raw graph as unknown.
implementation: Share strict dictionary and text-XRECORD inspectors with the existing replay planner. Admit omission only for a bounded same-revision IMAGE source whose root identity, unique dictionary entries and retained text-XRECORD owners are recognized and whose other raw objects are the explicitly omitted source raster objects. Existing source-block, paper-content and reference guards still apply.
validation: The missing-omission control failed before the fix. 85 focused IMAGE/persistence tests and 18 layout graph tests pass; source paper content, custom or nested dictionaries, wrong owners, foreign image identity and duplicate targets retain the conservative behavior.
A paper-space content edit refuses export without changing an existing destination; removing it permits a successful retry and reopen.

Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 reads selected R2010 model-space, named-block and anonymous-block outputs with the IMAGE and XRECORD owner present and zero audit errors or fixes. A separate source-paper-block control remains present and requires a peer orphan-block repair.
limits: Source IMAGEDEF/reactor records and their old dictionary entries are still intentionally dropped and reported; zero peer audit repairs do not prove identity or full graph preservation.

This gate covers selected same-revision generated sources, not binary conversion, broader graph shapes, clipped rendering, native producers or platform qualification. No generated drawing is committed.
